workbookName: Episode Dialog Copy — Craft Wave 2 (35 series)

rows.segment_title: Yo Gabba Gabba Live! - There's a Party in my City!
rows.story_lead: D.J. Lance Rock, Brobee, Toodee, Foofa, Plex and Muno play their first-ever live concert, with Biz Markie and Leslie Hall among the guests. There's a Party in My Tummy, Name Game and Get The Sillies Out are on the setlist for feet-on-the-floor singing.
rows.resolution: The concert is a sing-and-dance party from the first note, and there is no struggle to handle; the row leaves the fun as the fun.
rows.evidence_note: Synopsis-only: dev set note reads 'Synopsis-only (no script source for Season 0). Concert special: the fun is the show itself, so no coping moment is shown'; tier stands. Dev-set top-up carried (2026-11-14): fresh sweep found no Season 0 source (Gestdown does not carry the season; SubtitleCat returns nothing relevant; SubLoom lists no S0 subtitles). Topic: the story is a live sing-and-dance concert.

rows.segment_title: Yo! Fresh Beats Go Gabba Gabba!
rows.story_lead: A visit to the Singing Pizza Café puts the Gabba Gang face to face with the Fresh Beat Band. Meeting a favorite band in person and singing along is the day.
rows.resolution: There is no feeling to work through in a band meetup, and the row lets the music and the pizza café carry it.
rows.evidence_note: Synopsis-only: dev set note reads 'Synopsis-only (no script source for Season 0)'; tier stands. Topic per dev set: a band meetup at a pizza café; Food & cooking rides the setting, the story itself is the music. Dev-set top-up carried (2026-11-14): fresh sweep found no Season 0 source (Gestdown does not carry the season; SubtitleCat returns nothing relevant; SubLoom lists no S0 subtitles).

rows.story_lead: Toodee says she does not like yogurt, though she has never tasted it. The Try It song gets her to give it one taste, and one taste turns into loving it.
rows.resolution: The nervousness of a new food gets trying again, the give-it-one-taste move, and loving it is what the single taste earned.
rows.evidence_note: Script: dev set note reads 'Forever Dreaming transcript 01x01, content verified against catalog: Mark's potato bug drawing, Elijah Wood's puppet master Dancey Dance, the party in Brobee's tummy song, the snack line-up, the clean-up song'; core story is Toodee and the yogurt; confidence high. Coping stands in as give-it-a-try per dev set. Calibration house call carried: Yo Gabba Gabba! is musical throughout, so Music & dance is reserved for episodes where music or dance is the story itself, not the format.

rows.story_lead: Brobee is nervous about the magic bubbles popping until he learns popping is what bubbles love. Muno, meanwhile, learns how to cool off on a hot day, lemonade included.
rows.resolution: The worry of the popping gets reframed, bubbles ask to be popped, and the summer day ends in a pool party and jumpy-jump with everyone.
rows.evidence_note: Script: dev set note reads 'Forever Dreaming transcript 01x02, content verified against catalog: the bubbles asking to be popped, the lemonade how-to with Plex, the Aquabats pool party, jumpy-jump with everyone'; confidence high. Dev-set honesty note carried: the catalog synopsis mentions a Wait Your Turn patience song; the fetched transcript does not show that beat, so the tags rest on what the transcript shows.

rows.story_lead: Plex the robot does not know what fun means, and he asks. The gang shows him that fun is doing what you love with friends, and playing together turns out to be the funnest thing of all.
rows.resolution: The confusion gets asking for help, and the answer arrives as a body-music-and-dance lesson with the Aggrolites' banana on the side.
rows.evidence_note: Script: dev set note reads 'Forever Dreaming transcript 01x03, content verified against catalog: the breakfast party-in-my-tummy with eggs and fresh fruit, Plex asking what is fun, the body-music and dance lesson, the Aggrolites banana performance'; confidence high. Topics per dev set: the story's center is an idea (what fun means), not a controlled topic.

rows.story_lead: Muno runs too fast and accidentally breaks Toodee's castle. The episode shows him saying a real sorry and helping fix what he broke.
rows.resolution: The guilt of the broken castle gets apologizing, the I-am-so-sorry song and the fix-it-together ending, and dance is the episode's stated subject from the do-it dance to the freeze game.
rows.evidence_note: Script: dev set note reads 'Forever Dreaming transcript 01x04, content verified against catalog: the do-it dance, the freeze game, the jumping jellyfish Dancey Dance, Migu's drum cool trick, the I-am-so-sorry song and the fix-it-together ending'; confidence high. Dev calibration carried: guilty is the ratified term for I-did-not-mean-it feelings; the episode teaches apologizing exactly. Music & dance tagged because dance is the episode's stated subject.

rows.story_lead: Toodee hides because she does not want a nap, and Muno cannot fall asleep and feels lonely at night. Rest turns out to be what makes fast running possible, and happy thoughts carry him to sleep.
rows.resolution: The loneliness of the dark gets reframed, literally thinking happy thoughts, and the calm of a well-rested morning is what the shake-the-wiggles-out game was for.
rows.evidence_note: Script: dev set note reads 'Forever Dreaming transcript 01x05, content verified against catalog: the shake-the-wiggles-out game, Toodee hiding at nap time, the pajamas how-to, Smoosh's pajama party, Mark's dog drawing, Muno's lonely-night song and the think-happy-thoughts resolution'; confidence high. Coping per dev set: shown literally as thinking happy thoughts, mapped to reframing/distraction; naming the feeling also appears.

rows.story_lead: Brobee feels sad, and a hug lifts him while Foofa sings that it is okay to be a little sad. Foofa, for her part, learns it is okay to lose at tag sometimes.
rows.resolution: The sadness gets asking for comfort, shown literally as asking for a hug, and the happy of the Salteens' song is what dancing it out sounds like.
rows.evidence_note: Script: dev set note reads 'Forever Dreaming transcript 01x06, content verified against catalog: Archibald's worm babies and the not-afraid-of-worms song, Brobee's hug song, the Salteens, Foofa's it-is-okay-to-be-a-little-sad song, Foofa losing at tag'; confidence high. Coping per dev set: shown literally as asking for a hug. The Kites Are Fun animation is logged for the standing kites topic candidate only, not tagged.

rows.story_lead: Muno invites each friend to play, and Foofa and Muno both want their dances watched. Taking turns is the lesson, along with Brobee learning to keep his hands to himself.
rows.resolution: The happiness of having a friend over gets patience, waiting shown as the take-turns dance, and the sharing song plus the high-five lesson round out the polite part.
rows.evidence_note: Script: dev set note reads 'Forever Dreaming transcript 01x07, content verified against catalog: the find-a-friend song, the sharing song, the high-five lesson for Plex, the peanut butter stomp Dancey Dance, the take-turns dance, the hands-to-yourself song'; confidence high. Coping per dev set: taking turns is shown as waiting patience.

rows.story_lead: Toodee falls and loses the race, and she learns to shake a small hurt off and get back in. Muno's snowball hits Plex, and his lesson is a sorry plus watching where he throws.
rows.resolution: The sadness of the lost race gets trying again, the shake-it-off song, and the apology arc does the rest of the careful work.
rows.evidence_note: Script: dev set note reads 'Forever Dreaming transcript FD 01x08 Careful, title-matched not number-matched; content verified: the rocket up-and-down game, the family tree song, Toodee's fall in the race and the shake-it-off song, Muno's snowball apology and don't-throw-things-at-friends song, the snack how-to'; confidence high. Coping per dev set: shake it off and race again is trying again; the apology arc is shown in the situation. Topic anchored to the race itself.

rows.story_lead: Foofa skips, Tony Hawk teaches skateboarding with helmet and pads, and the day holds both quiet listening and loud wiggling. Each, the episode says, has its moment.
rows.resolution: There is no feeling to work through in a movement lesson, and the row lets the wiggle-hold-still game and the skateboard carry it.
rows.evidence_note: Script: dev set note reads 'Forever Dreaming transcript FD 01x12 Move, title-matched; content verified: the wiggle-hold-still game, the clean-your-room pick-it-up song, Ricky Fitness's drums, skipping with Foofa, the wash-your-hair how-to, Tony Hawk's skateboard Dancey Dance with helmet and pads, the quiet-birds versus loud song'; confidence high. Coping left empty with reason per dev set. Calibration flag carried: whether ride-on toys fit Things that go or it should stay vehicle-only.

rows.story_lead: Hellos, goodbyes and the please-and-thank-you magic words fill the day. Then comes the hard part, saying a sad goodbye to the magic ball friends, with the comfort that friends always come back to play.
rows.resolution: The sadness of the goodbye gets reframed, the comfort that friends always come back to play, and the happiness of the next hello is what the you-can-see-your-friends-again resolution promises.
rows.evidence_note: Script: dev set note reads 'Forever Dreaming transcript FD 01x11 Greetings, title-matched; content verified: the hello and hello-goodbye songs, the name game, the please-and-thank-you magic words, the excuse-me magic balls, Toodee missing the magic ball friends and the you-can-see-your-friends-again resolution'; confidence high. Coping per dev set: remembering friends return, mapped to reframing/distraction.

rows.story_lead: Muno bites Foofa mid-game, and the lesson lands without ceremony: we never bite our friends. He says sorry, and they play again.
rows.resolution: The hurt of the bite gets apologizing, Muno's real sorry, and the don't-bite-your-friends song does the teaching while the game resumes.
rows.evidence_note: Script: dev set note reads 'Forever Dreaming transcript FD 01x13 Together, title-matched; content verified: the eyes-nose-mouth face song, the love-every-living-thing song, the baby-steps-big-steps game joined one friend at a time, the horse pretend, Nikki Flores's twirly whirly, Mark's monkey drawing, Muno biting Foofa and the don't-bite-your-friends song with his apology'; confidence high. Content consideration carried: biting.

rows.story_lead: The lights go out and Muno is scared of the dark, and his friends name the fear right out loud. They stay beside him and sing him through it until Plex brings the lights back.
rows.resolution: The scare of the dark gets asking for comfort, the I-am-right-here-and-I-will-help-you song, and the brave shows up in staying rather than in the lights coming back.
rows.evidence_note: Script: dev set note reads 'Forever Dreaming transcript FD 01x09 Scary, title-matched not number-matched; content verified: Muno scared in the dark, the don't-be-afraid song with I am right here and I will help you, Brobee joining the fear, Plex turning the lights back on, plus the avocado try-it reprise and the tiny ugly germs song'; confidence high. Coping per dev set: the friends name the feeling and offer presence; shown literally as asking for and receiving comfort.

rows.story_lead: Costumes go on and the trick-or-treat song carries the night, and then the too-much-candy tummy ache teaches its moderation lesson the hard way. The falling-leaves fall song sets the season.
rows.resolution: The tummy ache is a consequences lesson rather than a feeling work-out, and the row leaves it there; the happiness of the dress-up celebration is what the night keeps.
rows.evidence_note: Script: dev set note reads 'Forever Dreaming transcript FD 01x10 Halloween, title-matched; content verified: the falling-leaves fall song, costumes and dress-up pretend, the trick-or-treat song, the too-much-candy tummy ache and moderation lesson'; confidence high. Coping left empty with reason per dev set. Calibration flag carried: whether party-type holidays belong under Birthday & party.

rows.story_lead: Foofa keeps trying until her seat belt clicks, and the gang holds hands and looks both ways. Toodee and Brobee learn never to chase a ball into the road, after a near miss the episode does not soften.
rows.resolution: The scare of the street gets trying again, Foofa's keep-trying buckle with its be-patient-don't-give-up beat, and the remember song models quieting down to think.
rows.evidence_note: Script: dev set note reads 'Forever Dreaming transcript FD 01x15 Car, title-matched; content verified: the buckle-up beat with be patient keep trying don't give up, the look-both-ways-and-hold-a-hand song, the ball-in-the-street near miss and the dangerous song, the electric eel Dancey Dance, Brobee's lost pillow Socky and the remember song with quiet-down-and-think'; confidence high. Coping anchored per dev set to Foofa's keep-trying buckle; the remember song also models quieting down to think, logged as a deep-breath-family strategy mention.

rows.story_lead: Muno learns to ask instead of just wanting, and Brobee discovers sharing is more fun than keeping. Toodee grabs a ball and learns to say sorry and wait her turn.
rows.resolution: Toodee's grab and the sad that follows get apologizing, the say-you're-sorry-and-wait-your-turn song, and the throw-roll-kick-and-catch games are what sharing was for.
rows.evidence_note: Script: dev set note reads 'Forever Dreaming transcript FD 01x16 Share, title-matched; content verified: the presents yours-and-mine song, Muno asking Foofa to share, Brobee's I-love-to-share turn, the throw-roll-kick-and-catch games, Toodee taking the ball and the say-you're-sorry-and-wait-your-turn song'; confidence high. Coping anchored per dev set to the grabbing incident; waiting your turn (patience) is also shown.

rows.story_lead: A hide-and-peekaboo game opens the day, and Toodee and Brobee spot the fish under the ice. The woodpecker mystery in the tree gets solved, and Muno does not give up until he finds his toy snake.
rows.resolution: The finding gets trying again, Muno's don't-give-up and think-really-hard snake search, and the what-was-that-sound investigation ends with the woodpecker named.
rows.evidence_note: Script: dev set note reads 'Forever Dreaming transcript FD 01x17 Find, title-matched; content verified: the I-like-fish song with salmon and trout, the won't-somebody-come-and-play song, the hide-and-peekaboo game, Toodee's sound game, Sean Kingston's mini spinny, Mark's truck drawing, the what-was-that-sound woodpecker investigation, Muno's toy-snake search with don't-give-up and think-really-hard'; confidence high. Topic anchored to the hiding-and-seeking game.

rows.story_lead: The gang builds one long train out of found things, with Plex's magic wheels making it go. Muno's first train ride is less scary with friends right there saying we will help you.
rows.resolution: The scare of the first ride gets asking for comfort, the friends naming the fear and staying present, and the I-helped-feel-safe turn is what the teamwork-built train carried.
rows.evidence_note: Script: dev set note reads 'Forever Dreaming transcript FD 01x18 Train, title-matched; content verified: the working-together teamwork song, the found-parts train with Plex's magic wheels, Muno's don't-be-afraid train ride and I-helped-feel-safe resolution, Foofa's maze game, Laila Ali's the-dog Dancey Dance, the inside-outside voice game'; confidence high. Coping per dev set: friends naming the fear and staying present, shown literally as we are right here and we will help you.

rows.story_lead: After a day of skating, snow angels and tree decorating one-at-a-time, the gang makes secret homemade presents for friends. Each gift comes with a thank you, for-me-for-you.
rows.resolution: There is no feeling to work through in a giving celebration, and the row lets the making-presents song and the Snow Princess's snowy jingle carry it.
rows.evidence_note: Script: dev set note reads 'Forever Dreaming transcript FD 01x14 Christmas, title-matched; content verified: Toodee's winter-favorite-season song, tree decorating one-at-a-time, the Snow Princess snowy jingle, Mark's snowman drawing, the making-presents song and the for-me-for-you-thank-you exchange'; confidence high. Coping left empty with reason per dev set. Same calibration flag as the Halloween row on party-type holidays.

rows.story_lead: Brobee keeps trying until he blows up his own balloon and calls it his best friend. Toodee learns to be nice to sad Gooble even when his crying is hard to be around.
rows.resolution: The frustration of the not-yet-balloon gets trying again, the don't-stop-don't-give-up song, and the Gooble arc stays a kindness lesson rather than a self-regulation strategy.
rows.evidence_note: Script: dev set note reads 'Forever Dreaming transcript FD 01x19 Love, title-matched; content verified: Brobee's balloon-blowing with the don't-stop-don't-give-up song, the I-found-love song, Brobee's my-friend-the-balloon best-friends song, the Postmarks balloons performance, Foofa's I-love-flowers song, Gooble crying and Toodee's go-cry-somewhere-else moment corrected by the be-nice-to-everyone song'; confidence high. Coping anchored per dev set to the literal keep-trying balloon beat; the Gooble arc models kindness to a sad friend rather than a self-regulation strategy.

rows.story_lead: Foofa pretends her dolphin wish into a swim, and the imagination games are going well until Toodee lies about magic beans to look cool. She owns it, and learns friends like her best when she tells the truth.
rows.resolution: The guilt of the lie gets apologizing, the why-did-you-lie song and a real apology with a promise to tell the truth, and the x-ray body song plays the day out.
rows.evidence_note: Script: dev set note reads 'Forever Dreaming transcript FD 01x20 Imagine, title-matched; content verified: the let's-pretend imagination song, the balloons song cheering sad Brobee up and Brobee sharing balloons back, the Shins sometimes-you-win-sometimes-you-lose song, Toodee's magic-bean lie, the why-did-you-lie song and her real apology, the x-ray body song'; confidence high. Coping per dev set: shown literally as a named apology and a promise to tell the truth.

rows.story_lead: Brobee wakes sure that everyone forgot his birthday, and the no-one-remembered song is heavy. Then the surprise party he never saw coming fills the day with balloons, cake and friends.
rows.resolution: The sadness of feeling forgotten ends in the reveal rather than in a strategy Brobee shows, and DJ Lance's remember-your-birthdays song counts the candles to four.
rows.evidence_note: Script: dev set note reads 'Forever Dreaming transcript FD 02x02 Birthday, title-matched not number-matched; content verified: Brobee's no-one-remembered song, DJ Lance's remember-your-birthdays song counting candles to four, the surprise-party verses for each friend, Biz's happy-birthday beat, Parker's cake-baking cool trick, Melora's birthday party dancey dance'; confidence high. Coping left empty with reason per dev set: the turn comes from the party reveal, not a strategy Brobee shows. Topic is the episode's core.

rows.story_lead: Brobee sits out of DJ Lance Says after a mistake, and in freeze tag he wants to give up, I-can't-win-I'm-too-tired. Keep-trying coaching and a snack-and-water energy fix bring him back.
rows.resolution: Quitting is what Brobee wants, and trying again is what the coaching and the fuel-up earn; the biggest trophy goes to the one who never gave up and had the most fun.
rows.evidence_note: Script: dev set note reads 'Forever Dreaming transcript FD 02x03 Games, title-matched; content verified: the DJ-Lance-Says game with Brobee's mistake and I-don't-want-to-play moment, the keep-trying coaching, freeze tag with Brobee's I-can't-win-I'm-too-tired and the snack-and-water energy fix, Mark's golf drawing, the Captain Gator story where the biggest trophy goes to the one who never gave up and had the most fun, the marching game include-everyone beat'; confidence high. Coping per dev set: shown literally as keep trying; naming that games are just for fun also appears.

rows.story_lead: Every friend names a talent while Brobee worries he has none, I-can't-think-of-anything. He keeps thinking, discovers his drums, and works up the nerve to play them at the talent show.
rows.resolution: The worry of having no talent gets trying again, keep thinking and performing anyway, and the shy-but-scared moment before the drums ends in the cheering close.
rows.evidence_note: Script: dev set note reads 'Forever Dreaming transcript FD 02x05 Talent, title-matched; content verified: the everyone-has-a-talent song, each friend's talent verse, Brobee's I-can't-think-of-anything and the don't-stop-don't-give-up keep-thinking song, his drum discovery, his I-feel-shy-but-I'm-scared moment before performing, the cheering close'; confidence high. Coping anchored per dev set to keep thinking and performing anyway. Music & dance per dev set: the talent the story turns on is drumming at a show.

rows.story_lead: Quiet listening solves the squeaky-sound mystery of a fox family, and Muno follows animal tracks, whisper-soft, straight to the deer that made them. Foofa's animal book starts the adventure.
rows.resolution: There is no feeling to work through on the animal-finding adventure, and the row lets the mystery and the deer reveal carry it.
rows.evidence_note: Script: dev set note reads 'Forever Dreaming transcript FD 02x10 Animals, title-matched; content verified: Foofa's animal book, the what-was-that-sound fox-pup mystery, the animal-sounds song, the who-made-these-tracks song and the deer reveal, Jimmy Eat World's beautiful day, the fox-on-the-run dance, the animal dance-card game'; confidence high. Coping left empty with reason per dev set. Topics per dev set: animals is deliberately not one of the eight controlled topics per the starter vocabulary's cast-bias ruling.

rows.story_lead: Muno does not like getting wet, and the rain looks like a ruined day. Then he sees the rain feed the plants, finds the fun in it, and the rainbow leaves treasure seeds at its end.
rows.resolution: The spoiled day gets reframed, the I-guess-it's-not-so-bad turn with its plants-and-animals-need-water reason, and the sunshine-is-here song closes the weather out.
rows.evidence_note: Script: dev set note reads 'Forever Dreaming transcript FD 02x07 Weather, title-matched; content verified: Muno's I-don't-like-the-rain verses and the I-guess-it's-not-so-bad turn, the plants-and-animals-need-water reason, the rainbow and the magic-seed treasure, Paul Williams's Rainbow Connection, the sunshine-is-here song, the rain-cloud dance'; confidence high. Coping per dev set: shown as the reframe of a disliked day into a good one.

rows.story_lead: Muno's new glasses make the world clear, and the friends' weird is what they draw. The mean-words lesson lands, DJ Lance names that it hurt his feelings, and a real sorry follows.
rows.resolution: The sadness of the teasing gets apologizing, the don't-say-mean-things-to-friends song and the friends' real sorry, and different ends up feeling cool.
rows.evidence_note: Script: dev set note reads 'Forever Dreaming transcript FD 02x09 Differences, title-matched; content verified: Muno tripping and the eye check, the I-got-glasses razzle-dazzle song, Brobee and Toodee calling him weird, the don't-say-mean-things-to-friends song, DJ Lance naming that it hurt his feelings, the apology, the just-because-it's-different song, the Argyle octopus family-skin story'; confidence high. Coping anchored per dev set to the friends' apology and repair; the naming-the-feeling beat also appears. Content consideration carried: peer teasing.

rows.story_lead: Plex's red light blinks mid-play, and the gang learns that machines need energy just like kids need food. They plug him in and dance the robot recharge.
rows.resolution: The row treats the repair as practical help rather than an emotional strategy, and no feeling work is claimed where none is shown.
rows.evidence_note: Script: dev set note reads 'Forever Dreaming transcript FD 02x08 Robot, retrieved from Exa cache after repeated live-fetch failures; content verified: Plex's what-is-a-robot lesson and the robot-friend song, the pinecone tricks, the energy-low red light and I-think-Plex-is-broken beat, the electricity-recharge song at his station, the robot-recharge dance, Money Mark's robot-friends song, the robot game'; confidence high. Coping left empty with reason per dev set: an explanation adventure with no feeling to work through; the repair is practical help, not an emotional strategy.

rows.story_lead: Muno's first wiggly tooth feels like losing a piece of himself, and he cries that he likes his teeth. Toodee normalizes it, they wiggle along together, and the fall-out that does not hurt ends in tooth-fairy gold coins.
rows.resolution: The scare of the losing gets asking for comfort, Toodee's everyone's-baby-teeth-fall-out reassurance and shared memory, and the keep-wiggling persistence does the rest.
rows.evidence_note: Script: dev set note reads 'Forever Dreaming transcript FD 02x01 Teeth, title-matched; content verified: Muno's fall-out-no-way-I-like-my-teeth cry, Toodee normalizing that everyone's baby teeth fall out and sharing her memory, the wiggle-wiggle-back-and-forth song together, it-didn't-even-hurt relief, the tooth-fairy explanation and good-night verse, the two gold coins and the pet-horse-and-cowboy-hat choice, Datarock's smile-for-the-camera, the brush-brush-brush song'; confidence high. Coping anchored per dev set to the reassurance and shared-experience comfort that settles the fear; the keep-wiggling persistence beat also appears.

rows.story_lead: Plex's icky alerts reveal the tiny ugly germs riding on sneezes, high fives and dirty hands. Supersoapy Pal shows that soap, bubbles and scrubbing send them right down the drain.
rows.resolution: There is no feeling to work through in a hygiene lesson, and the row lets the we-can-beat-them-with-Supersoapy-Pal reveal do the teaching.
rows.evidence_note: Script: dev set note reads 'Forever Dreaming transcript FD 02x20 Clean, title-matched; content verified: the icky-alert warnings over the high five and the flower-planting sandwich, the tiny-ugly-germs song, the we-can-beat-them-with-Supersoapy-Pal reveal, the wash-your-hands and scrub-aways-the-germs verses, Chromeo on the Super Music Friends Show'; confidence high. Coping left empty with reason per dev set: a hygiene lesson with no feeling to work through.

rows.story_lead: Jack crash-lands in a strange place where everyone looks different, lost and out of gas, and the oogey-boogie worry song plays. The strangers turn out to be friends who say don't be scared, we can help you.
rows.resolution: The scare of being lost gets asking for help, Jack's direct I-need-some-help line, and the new-friends-put-a-smile-on-my-face verses are what the rescue rides on.
rows.evidence_note: Script: dev set note reads 'Forever Dreaming transcript FD 02x17 New Friends, title-matched; content verified: the low-gas crash landing, Minibike's oogey-boogies line, the it's-not-fun-to-get-lost and who-are-these-creatures worry songs, Jack's I-need-some-help line, the gang's don't-worry-we-can-help-you-we-are-all-friendly song, the disco-roll dancey dance, the new-friends-put-a-smile-on-my-face verses, the yo-dazzlers song'; confidence high. Coping anchored per dev set to Jack's direct ask for help and the friends' response; the reassurance beat also appears.

rows.story_lead: The day is for caring for the world: watering flowers and plants, fueling up with fruit, and answering the talking trash that belongs in the can, not on the ground. Watering is what gives flowers their powers, the trash sings about its can, and fruit fuels the rest.
rows.resolution: No feeling to work through exists in an earth-care lesson, and the row lets the flowers-get-their-powers-from-water song and the keep-the-world-clean song carry it.
rows.evidence_note: Script: dev set note reads 'Forever Dreaming transcript FD 02x04 Green, title-matched; content verified: the flowers-get-their-powers-from-water song, the fruit song, Mark's tree drawing, the banana-juice snack, the talking-trash throw-us-away song, the counting-on-you keep-the-world-clean song, the crazy daisy dance'; confidence high. Coping left empty with reason per dev set. Topics per dev set: environmental care has no controlled topic; the fruit and cooking beats are segments, not the story.

rows.story_lead: Foofa and Brobee go quiet in front of Muno's visiting family, teeth-chattering silence and all. Plex's name-plus-nice-to-meet-you greeting gets everyone talking, and their second attempt sticks.
rows.resolution: The nervousness of meeting new grown-ups gets trying again, the taught greeting script and the second attempt, and the that's-my-family song carries the visits home.
rows.evidence_note: Script: dev set note reads 'Forever Dreaming transcript FD 02x14 Family, title-matched; content verified: the surprise visit, the oldest-to-youngest family introductions, the that's-my-family song, Foofa and Brobee's teeth-chattering silence, Plex modeling say-your-name-and-nice-to-meet-you, the it's-nice-to-meet-you song and their second attempt, DJ Lance's sister Kimba arriving, the family music cool trick'; confidence high. Coping anchored per dev set to trying again with a taught greeting script; noted as a judgment call since the shown tool is a social script rather than a named feeling strategy.

rows.story_lead: Muno spills paint on Foofa's picture at the art show, and her you-always-wreck-everything brings tears and the don't-say-mean-things song. Two sorries and a helping hand rebuild the painting.
rows.resolution: The wrecked picture gets apologizing, the two-way sorry, and Muno helping paint a fresh one is what the ooh-ahh art-show songs celebrate.
